text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At the academy, I come across El
Condor Pasa
and Mejiro Dober talking in
the hallway.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Next week, it's finally happening! Handshakes! Singing! Dancing! A super-fun social exchange with all our fans!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Haha. You're so full of energy, El. Me,
on the
other hand... I'm so nervous my
hands are shaking.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Don't sweat it! You're just shaking with

excitement! Let's really enjoy this event,
okay?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I even sent my mask to the cleaners!
They're going to restore it to
its ultimate glory!
I'm already itching for
the day so I can wear it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Inhale... Exhale... Today's the day. Are you ready?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Maybe... not...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What? Why?! And where's your mask?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I was expecting to get it back from the
cleaners this morning, but... there was a
mistake, and it's
going to take a little
more time...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
But... I can't keep everyone waiting. I
have no
choice but to do this maskless.

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
Without further ado, I'd like to welcome
to the
stage El Condor Pasa and Mejiro
Dober!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Urk... H-hello, everyone...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I feel honored that... so many of you
have, uh...
come to this event today.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
What's going on? She's not wearing her
mask...
And she's acting totally different
from usual.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
U-um! Thank you, everyone, for
attending our
event t-today!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I-I was so excited for it that I... um, couldn't sleep last night. Well, I mean—I did get some sleep!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Oh, Dober...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
(Dober's no good at this kinda stuff, but
she's
trying so hard for my sake! And
look at me!)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
(I am without my mask... But! I'm not
without
courage! And if I muster all the
courage I have,
then!)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
M-me too! I was so excited last night
that I didn't
sleep a wink!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
But that's because I just couldn't wait to
have the
greatest, most fantástico,
all-out day ever with all
of you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: E-El!

text_block_list.name: Cleaner
text_block_list.text:
Heeey! Sorry about earlier, El! Here's
your mask!
All nice and clean!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Qué?! For real?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to have kept y'all waitin'! That
goes for you,
too, Dober!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: The revival, the rebirth—the great arrival of the true El Condor Pasaaaa!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Phew! Thank you so much, Dober. I was
really
worried for a minute there!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Guess I'm no good without my mask
after all.
Haha...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hey, that's not true. You showed a ton
of courage
even without it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Your mask is really important too, that's
for sure,
but... that courage to take on
anything—you had
it all along.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: So, you're saying that maybe my heart wears its own mask of courage?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: My running is the best, my heart is the best—I am the best! Wow! I feel like I could jump over the moon right now!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...But, you know, I only found that
courage
because you did your best to
help me out!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It's just like I said when I introduced us
at that
trial wrestling lesson—we really
are the best tag
team ever!
